label: TP
reason: Single alert java/xss is alert-TP. User input from request.getParameter() flows to bar variable via direct assignment, then bar is written unsanitized to HTML response sink at line 35. While double quotes are escaped ("), single quotes remain unescaped in the HTML attribute context (data-name=''), enabling attackers to break out of the attribute boundary using single quotes (e.g., input containing '><script>) resulting in attacker-controlled content reaching the sink expression.

evidence.note: User parameter assigned to bar, then bar interpolated into HTML response without full sanitization for single quotes
